title: Evidence receipt pipeline
description: Objective: build immutable verification recipes, clean candidate rematerialization, verifier execution, and local evidence-key receipts. Deliverable: focused runner evidence modules over the clean workspace foundation. NOT in scope: trusting agent prose, independent reviewer judgment, or graph fan-in. Hard dependencies: Clean workspace foundation, External effect supervisor, and Projection outbox core. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/evidence/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: Agent-reported text cannot satisfy a verification obligation.
Receipts bind exact argv, input/result tree, environment/runtime, output, timestamps, recipe, graph, lease, and effect identities.
Fresh rematerialization rejects foreign or undeclared bytes and any digest/signature tamper fails closed.
The focused runner typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
